question: On what consent, notice and retention does the institution keep a pseudonymous workbook and the names, roles and free-text notes of the people it describes, which payment processor may receive the workbook identifier, and when is an unclaimed workbook deleted?
decision: Provide a clear notice, legal basis and retention statement before collecting named third-party memory-holder notes; advise minimization and offer removal/correction requests. Use an opaque checkout reference not derived from workbook ID, avoid transmitting workbook content to Stripe, and expire/delete unclaimed content after 30 days with an audited job. Retain payment/consent evidence separately under its proper schedule; claimed records follow tenant retention, privacy rights and legal holds.
originalProposedDecision: Show a notice and record consent at start. Stripe receives an opaque checkout reference, not the workbook id. Unclaimed workbooks are deleted after 30 days; notes about named people carry a 'do not include sensitive personal information' notice.
